intro: The Encrypted Scroll is a discreet summons delivered to freshly awakened Forsaken rogues in Deathknell. Passed along by Shadow Priest Sarvis, the cipher directs the recruit to David Trias, a rogue mentor operating quietly out of the local inn.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the adventurer trainer David Trias. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: So you've made it? Good, we'll have need of more adventurers as time goes on. The Shadowstalkers will probably wind up finding you when they think the time's right, so don't go and slip up or do anything you might regret. They need talented agents... Not pickpockets and fools.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I spend most of my time here in the inn keeping an eye out for new faces and just keeping tabs on up-and-coming prospects. Keep your nose clean and I'll do what I can to teach you a few things. Just come back to me whenever you want, and we'll see if you're ready for a new skill or two.
